solutionSignature: ADAPT the existing immutable round-start assignment core to expose a current exact-hand3/all-three fixed RSP assignment mode with native suit retained as card data and an externally supplied assignment-policy result, while retaining the existing legacy suit-bound mode only as a compatibility seam until the live caller is migrated.
solutionSearchEvidence: The existing core already owns fixed R/S/P slot identity, immutable same-round snapshot reuse, source-card identity, and ordinary-hand exclusion.
Latest USER_EXPLICIT supersedes arbitrary-hand suit-bound membership: every turn hand=3, all three cards autoassign to fixed R/S/P, native suit remains separate.
The exact mapping policy among the three positions is not USER-fixed; the core validates an externally supplied policy result rather than inventing card-order, suit, random, or strength semantics.
Keeping the old mode behind an explicit compatibility path prevents the current live caller from breaking before its separate owner-free migration.
